sentence_stem: Of all the cities we visited,
full_sentence: Of all the cities we visited, Kraków was the most beautiful.
acceptable_variants: Kraków was the most beautiful city we saw.

options.text: we took the most photos in Gdańsk.
options.why_wrong: This describes how many photos were taken, not which city is the most beautiful, so it does not answer the comparison the stem sets up.
'More beautiful' is a comparative, which needs 'than' followed by a second item; the stem sets up a superlative with 'the most'.

options.text: we spent the least time in Wrocław.
options.why_wrong: This is a superlative, but it describes time spent rather than beauty, so it does not complete the comparison.

grammar_focus: Superlative adjectives with 'the most' after 'of all'
explanation: The phrase 'of all' signals a superlative comparison, so the completion needs 'the most' with an adjective. Learners may be tempted to use a comparative form here, but a comparison with a group of several items always requires a superlative.
translation: Ze wszystkich miast, które odwiedziliśmy, Kraków był najpiękniejszy.
